findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 列示競爭對手為 Air Liquide、Air Products、Messer、Taiyo Nippon Sanso 及大量中小地方業者；管線網絡所在地為 Linde 的競爭優勢。未點名新進入者。
findings.excerpt: In locations where Linde has pipeline networks, which enable the company to provide reliable and economic supply of products to larger customers, Linde derives a competitive advantage.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 兩次搜尋未找到 2025–2026 份額消長的可靠來源或具名新進入者／替代供應商搶單報導；聚合站份額數字來源不明，不採用。
